summary: Granger causality directly tests H004 prediction P002: SH→NH causality is confirmed at lag=5 months (p<0.0001), and NH→SH at lag=1 month. The asymmetry (NH drives SH at short lag, SH drives NH at medium lag) is consistent with H004's coupled oscillator model. The short NH→SH lag (1 month) may reflect rapid cloud/albedo response to NH forcing patterns, while the longer SH→NH lag (5 months) suggests SH sets the background state that modulates NH variability on seasonal timescales.
